mentions.name: Notepad95
mentions.description: A browser-based notepad for taking meeting notes in plain text files, giving the author's usual notepad.exe workflow its own separate browser tab.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://notepad95.com/
I still use regular notepad.exe and text files to take meeting notes. But I thought it'd be fun to have a seperate browser tab for it.
